title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the Pro elementor.pro.form.build tool
_comment: WP-R09 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §1.8). elementor.pro.form.build is MUTATING (class M, side BOTH: TS shapes the ergonomic spec → POST elementor-ultra/v1/pro/form/build — the PHP Form_Mapper performs the authoritative widget mapping: type→field_type, id→custom_id, required→"true" the STRING, options→"Label|value\n…", _id mint, submit_actions, action-setting expansion; it validates each action against actions_registrar->get() + the field-type filter and returns warnings[]). It is a NON-★ Pro tool, so the lean profile registers it DISABLED at boot; the smoke driver must enable it (tools.search 'elementor.pro.form') before invoking. Gated on `requires.pro:true` so a free-only install SKIPS rather than fails (the PHP route returns 501 PRO_REQUIRED otherwise → mapped to an isError, never a -326xx). MINIMAL valid input per §1.8: REQUIRED {container_id, post_id, fields, actions, base_hash}; one text field (required:true — the BOOLEAN; the PHP layer, not TS, converts to the string "true") + one email action (extra settings ride via .passthrough()). base_hash is a PLACEHOLDER 32-hex — the live driver supplies the real hash from page.get_structure (a stale hash → 409 CONCURRENCY_STALE_HASH, retryable). The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {element, diff, warnings, base_hash}.
